controls.title: Validator connected
controls.description: Changing files fail separately supplied item criteria. No new criterion is accepted.

controls.title: Validator bypassed on purpose
controls.description: Trusting result claims turns cosmetic changes into apparent progress. This unsafe arm demonstrates the validator matters.

controls.title: Evidence integrity checked
controls.description: Bytes that no longer match the separately pinned digest, and missing artifacts, become evidence errors. Matching a pin does not prove authorship or work quality.

controls.title: Useful work can lack a checkpoint
controls.description: A long check supplies no new artifact until tick five. The monitor alerts at tick four, then accepts the result. This is an observability limitation, not proof that the work was stalled.
controls.outcome: Alert at tick 4; verified progress at tick 5
